research.title: Evaluating Object Detection Under Simulated Motion Blur
bullets: Designed controlled experiments with supervisor guidance to assess detector sensitivity to motion blur, varying corruption severity while holding training conditions fixed.
Compared augmentation settings using per-class precision and recall, and inspected missed detections to distinguish localization errors from classification failures.

research.title: Boundary Sensitivity in Semantic Segmentation
bullets: Planned experiments with supervisor guidance comparing segmentation losses under consistent data splits, preprocessing procedures, and model initialization settings.
Evaluated region overlap and boundary agreement, examining prediction overlays to characterize errors around thin structures and visually ambiguous object edges.

work.title: Order Documentation and Stock Reconciliation
bullets: Checked incoming order paperwork against delivery records, flagged missing information, and routed discrepancies to the appropriate staff for follow-up.
Maintained stock logs, organized routine filing, and prepared shift handover notes documenting outstanding requests and unresolved delivery issues.

projects.title: Comparing Feature Representations for Image Classification
bullets: Implemented image classification pipelines using histogram of oriented gradients with a linear classifier and a convolutional network trained on the same dataset.
Compared validation accuracy and confusion matrices under matched data splits, inspecting representative errors to identify sensitivity to background clutter.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Classical Image Denoising
bullets: Implemented Gaussian smoothing and bilateral filtering for image denoising, applying synthetic Gaussian noise to clean images under consistent evaluation conditions.
Compared reconstruction quality using peak signal-to-noise ratio and structural similarity, examining edge preservation across filter settings and noise levels.
